info.title: Omega operator API
info.description: Authenticated commands, lifecycle events, operator projections, and reconnect recovery. See reference-omega-api.md and reference-dashboard.md for semantics.

get.description: Atomic projections and replay cursor. Recent record windows are bounded; durable journal is unpruned.

500.description: Internal failure; retry command with same request_id

post.description: Submit a command. Retry an uncertain outcome with the identical envelope and request_id. Maximum request body: 65536 bytes.

200.description: Completed atomic control or replayed request

409.description: Conflicting ID, state transition, instance, or cursor

500.description: Internal failure; retry command with same request_id

get.description: Read durable command status and original payload.

500.description: Internal failure; retry command with same request_id

get.description: Read a stored evidence record, including outside the snapshot window.

500.description: Internal failure; retry command with same request_id

get.description: Default: SSE activity and cursor frames, heartbeat comments, durable ordered replay after cursor. stream=0: JSON pages of up to 200 journal records. instance_id is mandatory for SSE. Types filtering applies to SSE only.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last processed sequence; defaults to Last-Event-ID or zero.

parameters.name: instance_id
parameters.description: Snapshot instance ID; required when stream is not 0.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Set 0 for a finite JSON page; default is a persistent SSE subscription.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact event types or families; e.g. run,evidence.

200.description: Ordered journal page or live stream

409.description: Conflicting ID, state transition, instance, or cursor

500.description: Internal failure; retry command with same request_id

get.description: Workbench projections and live service status. Use the full snapshot for a shared event cursor.

post.description: Exchange bearer authentication for an eight-hour HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie. Secure is added for HTTPS requests.

delete.description: Clear the browser session cookie. Does not rotate the root operator token.

operatorSession.name: omega_session
operatorSession.description: Signed, expiring same-origin session cookie issued by POST /session.
